node_definition.done_when: In _reap_worker_on_its_terminal_manifest (reckon/crew/dispatch.py), a deadline set when the manifest read complete or failed stays set when the worker later rewrites the manifest as blocked or in-progress, so the worker is still ended after the grace while it is working or waiting for resume. A manifest change whose status is not a done status clears the deadline. tests/test_a_terminal_worker_exits_within_its_grace.py gains a case: the stub writes complete, then rewrites blocked before the grace ends, then sleeps past the grace; the worker is still alive after the grace. The existing five cases keep passing. The declared negative control is executed and logged. Base and head arms of tests/test_a_terminal_worker_exits_within_its_grace.py, tests/test_stored_phase_advances.py and tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py show zero added failures.
